description: FLOODPY is Kleanthis Karamvasis, Alekos Falagas and contributors' Python toolbox for mapping non-urban flooded regions. It processes Sentinel-1 GRD intensity time series using statistical or vision-transformer methods, with meteorological context. Inputs include the flood date, geographic bounds and satellite acquisitions; outputs are flood-extent maps. Coverage and resolution depend on the selected scenes and event period. Source is free under GPL-3.0-or-later, confirmed in the licence file. Public notebooks and installation instructions support reuse; operational data retrieval requires Copernicus Data Space and Climate Data Store accounts. A limitation is that installation was tested only on Linux and the documented target is non-urban flooding, so urban results need separate evaluation. The maps can check hydraulic simulations and flood-defence exposure. RiverREM (platform-riverrem) is a related model-preparation tool. Only documentation was inspected; no account, satellite data or model weights were used.
name: FLOODPY flood mapping toolbox
